generic: They say the road out east has been quiet for weeks. Too quiet. The milestones past the fourth one count backwards now.
Prices went up again. Nobody will say who decided that, and the new figure is written in the ledger as one long word.
Somebody saw lights over the water three nights running. The same three nights, the fishermen say. The very same three.
The wells have tasted of iron since the spring. Iron, or blood, or oil. Ask anyone and they will each name a different one.
There is work going at the old yard, but nobody comes back talking about it. They come back humming. All of them the same tune.
A stranger passed through last week and paid in coins nobody recognised. The faces on them were still moving in the morning.
Half the town swears the bells rang at the wrong hour. The other half swears they rang yesterday.
The guards changed their patrol. That never happens for nothing. Now they walk it backwards and will not say why.
Word is a whole caravan turned back before it reached the pass. The ones who turned back arrived twice.
Something got into the storehouse. They are calling it dogs. Dogs do not fold the sacks afterwards.
The Tower opened on its own the night two billion people died. Nobody has managed to shut it since.
Keep the cart under eighty. Anything faster gets pulled into the nearest bubble, and out there nobody finds you, they only find the day again.
A trucker came through with a pigeon in a cage and a memory stick tied to its leg. Said it is the only post that crosses a loop.
The old man says magic wells up out of the oil and runs in the leylines. That is why they dig, and why the diggers are so careful how they talk.
They pulled a piece of the dead Father out of a field two counties over. Whoever touched it can do things now, and he was never a mage.
Say a spell with a space in it and the universe bills you for a transcendental. It starts with your voice and it does not stop there.
Rome is eight hundred metres off the ground these days, and the Citadel shoots at anything that flies up to look.
There has not been a clean launch in months. The debris grinds the rockets, so the spaceport at Taranto takes volunteers for nothing.
Mexico looks like Africa from above now. Same streets, same people, wrong shape entirely.
The goblins came up out of a Soviet borehole in 1970 and never went back down. Now they paint their faces before a fight and sing about it.
Do not do anything in front of a witness. She sees it, she prices it, and something comes at you in a straight line until it is on you.
Every note in your pocket carries his name more times than God's is written in all the bibles ever printed. Think about who that made rich.

nervous: I should not be saying this, but people have been going missing off the north road. Please do not repeat it. Their shadows still walk it.
You did not hear it from me. Something is wrong at the water works and nobody will admit it. The water comes out warm and it comes out thinking.
Every night this week I have heard someone moving outside. Every night. The same night, I think. I have stopped opening the shutters.
My cousin drove eighty-two on the coast road and came back four days later swearing it was still Tuesday. Please do not drive fast near me.
They say a bounty goes up the moment somebody sees you do it. I have started apologising to empty rooms, in case one of them is watching.
There is an Anoki phone in my drawer that has not needed charging since 1994, and last week it rang. I did not pick it up.
calm: There is talk of trouble at the border. There always is. The border moves at night. I would not act on it yet.
People are saying the harvest will fail. People say that most years, and most years the field is still in the same dimension.
A rumour is going around about the magistrate. I will wait until somebody puts a name to it, and until the name stops changing.
The Tower has stood since ninety-two. It holds the ninety-two dimensions together the way a flag holds a sandwich. Panicking has not shortened it.
The archivists set a checkpoint on the square. They will read your messages and publish them. Be dull and they lose interest.
Lava does not burn any more, it only drains you. Unless a mage conjured it. Then it does both.
aggressive: Somebody has been skimming the shipments, and when I find out who, they will be missing teeth. Twice, if the day loops.
Ask the pack at the tavern about the fight last week. Ask who started it. They will lie, and two of them were not born in this dimension.
There is a crew working this district that thinks nobody is watching. Something under the floor is watching. So am I.
Let the goblins come up the road singing. I have a bullet coated in Fantablack and it kills inside a loop.
The Collective sells clean water and cuts everything else with acid. One of their men priced my mother's memories. I priced his jaw.
The petrodemon under the refinery ate a whole regiment. Break the leyline first, they said. Nobody wanted to be the one to break it.
melancholic: The old family on the hill left in the night. Nobody has said why, and nobody will. Their lamp still comes on at the same hour.
They say the river took another one last month. It always takes somebody, and lately it gives back somebody else.
This place used to be full. Now the rumours are all we have left to pass around, and even those arrive secondhand from a day we already had.
The Verden by the mill still dream of the Green Fields. Dimension seventy-seven went first, and they were the ones who threw their machines into a star to be happy.
There is a goddess buried a few hundred kilometres straight down, pinned there by the Tower, and she is not dead enough to stop knowing about it.
Since the Father died the old prayers come back empty. My mother still says them. I do not tell her.
sanguine: Have you heard? There is going to be a festival, and the whole street is already arguing about the music. Two of the arguments are from next week.
Word is somebody came into money and is being very quiet about it. The money hums. Wonderful, isn't it?
Everyone is talking about the new arrival. She stepped off a camper that was not on the road a moment before. I intend to know everything by the week's end.
They fitted a liminal engine to the coach line, so the far coast is twenty minutes away. Twenty minutes! I have been three times and it was still Tuesday when I got back.
A catalogue from Esoteric Heavy Industries turned up with brooms in it and fusion reactors after them, and no carrier ever delivered it. It was simply in the warehouse.
They say there is a party up in the Citadel, eight hundred metres above Rome. I have decided that I am going up there.
cautious: I have heard the same story from three people, which is exactly why I do not trust it. Two of them were the same person.
There is supposed to be easy work down at the docks. Easy work usually costs something, and lately it costs a year you do not notice losing.
Check who holds the debt before you believe anything about that shop closing. Check twice if the ledger is written in one word.
Before you take that road, look at the circles marked on the map. They grow every year, and the ones drawn last winter are already too small.
If a man offers you a spell fused out of two others, ask where he got it. A vending machine is fine. A ritual, ask what he paid for it.
The Guild will help, they say. The Guild is two halves that hate each other, so ask which half turned up before you thank anybody.
impulsive: They say the vault under the mill is still full. I nearly went last night. I may have gone. The night is not clear.
There is a fight on at the yard right now, apparently. There was one yesterday too, exactly the same one. Come on.
Somebody left a whole cart unattended by the gate. A whole cart. Unattended since spring, and still warm.
That mechanic's engine takes a road turn-off into another dimension entirely. I only need a turn-off and something with wheels.
There is a hole in Antarctica that spirals all the way to the middle of the world and comes out in a city. I have a coat.
A seat on those armoured rockets is free because you probably die. Free! That is a bargain in one direction at least.
stoic: Talk says the winter will be hard. It usually is. It has been the same winter for a while now.
Two men vanished off the pass road. That is what the road does. That road is older than the world it runs through.
The prices climbed again. Complaining has never brought one down, and the man whose name is on the money is not a man any more.
The Tower is there. It will be there tomorrow. Everything else is negotiable.
A god dies when nobody will believe in them, turns to stone and drops into the White Desert. Quiet way to go. I have heard worse.
Stay under eighty and the day comes back. Go over it and it might not. There is work either way.
paranoid: Count the guards on the east gate. Then count them tomorrow. It is the same tomorrow. You will see.
The letters are being opened. I do not care who says otherwise, I have seen the seals, and I have seen them opened before they were sent.
Whoever is asking questions about the old warehouse is not asking for themselves. Ask them what they ate this morning. They will not know.
There is a thing a quarter the size of the Moon curled round the core of this planet and it drives one person at a time. Could be the mayor. Could be you.
Wrap your head. Foil, a proper layer of it. There are diseases that travel through a thought now and nobody is allowed to print that.
The archivists want everything public and the Collective wants everything priced. Between them they have your name twice. I use three.
empathetic: The family on the corner lost everything and the whole street is pretending not to notice. Some days the street forgets on purpose.
They say the innkeeper's boy has not been the same since the spring. He came out of a loop older than the year allows. I believe it.
There is gossip going round about her, and I wish people could hear themselves. She is not the first woman to lose her past to somebody else's ritual.
The girl who came off that camper lost ninety-two percent of what she was, and people ask about her power instead. That is the wrong half to be curious about.
There are whole villages living inside a loop and nobody visits. The truckers carry letters in. I send one every month.
The Naguka feel it as a species when you hurt one of them. Whatever else you think, imagine grieving with everyone at once.
authoritative: The shipment records do not add up, and I intend to have an answer by the week's end. The week's end has been slow in coming.
There is talk of a strike at the yard. It will be settled properly or it will be settled by me, preferably before the day resets.
Somebody is giving orders in this district who has no standing to give them, and no shadow to speak of either.
A Foundation officer walked in and demanded the ledgers be published. This district answers to me first and to the archive second.
If a bounty falls on anyone in my town, the charge will be read here before any judicial ghost comes down that road for them.
Three pillars decide how magic works for all of us, and not one of them has ever stood in this square. Remember that when the directive arrives.
scholarly: Three separate accounts describe the same lights over the marsh, and none agree on the colour. Two of the accounts predate their witnesses.
The archive lost a whole year of records to a fire that nobody recorded. The year is missing from the calendars too, if you count.
There is a manuscript circulating that claims the city is older than its charter. Poorly sourced, but it names the builders, and they were not people.
The Ritual of Solomon rewrites how magic works wherever it is cast. Crowley used it at the start of the century to hand magic to everybody, and kept it quiet.
Seven artifacts went into the last one: the Iron Crown, the Spear of Longinus, Tyrfing, clay from the Golem of Prague, the draconic clasp of Xia, a carved horn. I am still hunting the seventh.
The city under the crust was built between the dinosaurs and us, and they left no writing whatsoever. An empty capital and not one sentence. That is what keeps me awake.
artistic: The bells rang wrong on Tuesday and nobody else seems to have heard it. I have not stopped thinking about it. It was a Tuesday we had already had.
They say the painter on the square stopped taking work. I know why. He ran out of a colour that still exists.
Something in this town has changed colour this season. I cannot name it, but it has, and naming it might be exactly what it wants.
There is a black scraped off the outside of the Tower that eats light and holds the day still. I would give a hand for a thumbnail of it.
Four Norwegians became gods because enough goblins believed the music. That is what art is for, and it terrifies me.
The oldest story says a god made the first road and was the first thing killed on it. I think about that every time I paint one.
adventurous: There is a pass nobody has walked in ten years. I found a man who says it is open again, and another who says it opens onto somewhere else.
The maps are wrong about the north ridge and I intend to prove it. The circles on them are right, though. Never argue with the circles.
They say a ship came in with a hold full of things without names. Two of them have not finished being things yet. I want to see it.
The scraps of creation are pocket worlds the gods used as scratch paper, and since ninety-two some of them have doors. I only need the calibration.
Take the right turn-off on the Encompassing Road and you come out in another dimension. Every road is that road, they just do not all admit it.
The Serpentine Road opens in Antarctica and ends at a city wrapped round the centre of the Earth. I have written to three people about the coat I would need.
nurturing: Those children have been sleeping in the yard again. Somebody ought to do something, so I will. Some of them have been that age for years.
They say the old woman on the lane has not opened her door in days. I am going round with soup. She may have had this soup before.
There is sickness on the south side. Keep your people home if you can, and keep them off the telephone.
If it is one of the thought-borne ones, foil round the head, properly wrapped, and no arguing with me about how it looks.
There is a family in the loop past the ridge with a baby who will be new for a very long time. I send blankets in with the truckers.
Do not go to the leyline to pray. The power is larger there and it gets away from people. I have buried three who were certain it would not.
mischievous: You want to know who the constable's wife has been visiting? Buy me a drink. Buy me the same drink twice and I will tell you tomorrow as well.
Somebody swapped the ledgers at the customs house. I would never say who. The old ledgers are still in there arguing with the new ones.
There is a rumour going round that I started, and it has come back to me improved, in a voice not quite mine.
Write a spell wrong in a grimoire and it spreads through the book copying itself. I may have improved a Guild man's notebook while he slept.
The Collective will buy an emotion off you. I sold them an afternoon of feeling smug and they never checked whose afternoon it was.
Tune an old phone right and it reaches the afterlife. I have been calling a man who owes me, and he is not enjoying it much down there.
cynical: They say the new tax pays for the roads. Look at the roads. Now look at whose name is printed on the money paying for them.
Somebody will be blamed for the missing grain. It will not be whoever took it. It never is, in any of the ninety-two.
Every rumour in this town is a bill somebody is trying not to pay, and the throne sits at the top of a tower none of us will climb.
New York was hit and the world had a culprit inside a day. Convenient, having the name ready before the dust settled.
The Vatican keeps diplomats with the goblins. Not out of love. They want an army that already fights for free.
They call the Tower neutral ground. Every faction on Earth has an office inside it. That is not neutrality, that is a queue.
disciplined: The night watch has been three men short for a month. It is in the roster, if anybody bothered to read it. One of the three is on it twice.
Stores went out unlogged twice this week. That is how a place starts to rot, and rot travels faster than it used to.
There is talk about the new officer. I will judge them on their drills, not on gossip, and not on which dimension they trained in.
A rule is a rule: eighty and no faster on my roads. I do not care what your engine claims it can ignore.
A ritual works because it is done in order. Skip a step and you have not cast a spell, you have made a problem.
The truckers keep a hierarchy and a schedule and they still cross realities on time. There is a lesson in that for this town.
fatalistic: They say the mine will reopen. It will flood again, the same as before, on the same day as before.
Whatever is coming up the road is already on its way. Talking about it changes nothing. The road decided long before either of us.
The signs are all there. They were there last time too, and nobody moved. There will be a last time again.
By 2012 the arithmetic says nothing can live here. That is eleven years. People are still buying land.
The higher the dimension, the faster it goes. Seventy-seven is already empty. We are near the bottom and we still think we are early.
The bubbles widen every year and the maps are redrawn every year. One year the map will simply be a bubble.
grumpy: Everyone repeats the same nonsense about the bridge and not one of them has walked it. I walked it. Twice in the same afternoon, which is its own complaint.
They put a new stall on the square. Ruined the square. Half of it is not from here and it hums.
Somebody's dog got into the stores. I said this would happen. Nobody listened. It has been getting in since spring and it is never hungry.
The Foundation stopped me at the gate to publish my messages. I have no messages. They published that.
New engine on the coach and everyone delighted. It compresses the road. I liked the road the length it was.
Spells have to be one word now, by law of the universe. Ridiculous language. Nobody put it to a vote.
loyal: People are saying things about my employer that they would not say to his face, and they had better not. Some of them have said it twice already.
There is a rumour about the guard captain. I served under her. It is a lie, in this dimension and in any other.
Whatever you have heard about that family, they stood by this town when nobody else did, including the year the town forgot itself.
The truckers brought our medicine through a loop when nothing else could reach us. Say what you like about anybody else.
My house has been Vatican since before I was born, and Peter II may call whoever he likes the Antichrist. I still go to mass.
The Naguka lad at the forge is one of ours now. Touch him and the whole species knows. That is not a threat, it is simply how they are made.
brave: They say something is living in the drains under the market. I am going down there tomorrow. It has been tomorrow for a while.
Half the street will not walk past the old house after dark. I walk past it every night. Some nights it is longer than others.
There is talk of bandits on the east road. Let them come this way. Let whatever is behind them come too.
Petrodemon or not, break the leyline and it bleeds like anything else. Somebody has to be the one holding the pick.
They want volunteers at the spaceport and nine in ten do not come back down. I have put my name in.
The goblins come up the Kola shaft with their faces painted and I still say a wall is a wall and men hold it.
timid: I heard something about the tower, but please do not ask me to repeat it. The repeating is the part that matters, apparently.
People are talking, and I would rather not be seen talking with them. Being seen is how it starts.
There is a man asking about strangers. I did not tell him anything. I promise. I told him yesterday, but not today.
Somebody saw me take an apple. Just an apple. Do the judicial ghosts come for an apple? They come in a straight line, they say.
My aunt went to work in the Tower and her letters stopped at the fortieth floor. I have not asked anyone what is on the forty-first.
There was a spell written on the mill wall with a space in it. I did not read it out loud. I ran.
hedonistic: The cellar at the inn has something new in it and the innkeeper pretends it does not exist. It was not down there an hour ago.
They say there is a party at the big house that nobody is invited to. Nobody stays uninvited for long, and that evening has been going for eleven days.
Word is the new place on the square pours honestly. That is worth more than any secret, in a world where the water is cut.
The Collective sells the only clean water and puts acid in everything else. I have made my peace with the everything else.
There are people inside a loop who wake up on the same good night for ever. Tell me honestly what is wrong with that.
If you want a night you cannot repeat, drive over eighty. That is the only price the day charges any more.
apathetic: Something happened at the docks. People are upset about it. They were upset about it yesterday as well.
They say the council is falling apart. I suppose it might be. Something is always falling apart, at ninety-two dimensions' worth of pace.
There is a rumour going round. I have not bothered to learn which one. It will come round again.
Apparently the world ends in 2012. Everyone keeps mentioning it. It is not 2012.
A god died over New Year and the sky is where the body went. I looked once.
The Tower is the tallest thing that has ever existed and I have never gone. What would I do there.
